metadata.description: Multi-company financial IR benchmark covering statutory SEC Form 10-K sections across qualitative and quantitative inquiries.

queries.research_question: What primary consumer hardware products and subscription services does Apple manufacture and distribute?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: iPhone, Mac, iPad, Wearables, Home and Accessories, and Services including App Store, Apple Music, and iCloud
queries.annotation_notes: Ground truth annotated from Apple Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023.

queries.research_question: What was Apple's total consolidated net sales and product revenue in fiscal year 2023?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Total net sales were $383,285 million, compared to $394,328 million in 2022; product revenue was $298,085 million.
queries.annotation_notes: Extracted from MD&A Consolidated Results of Operations table in Apple FY2023 10-K.

queries.research_question: How did Apple's gross profit margin shift between fiscal year 2022 and fiscal year 2023?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Gross margin percentage was 44.1% in 2023 compared to 43.3% in 2022, driven by higher Services mix and cost savings.
queries.annotation_notes: Item 7 MD&A gross margin analysis table and narrative.

queries.research_question: What operational and manufacturing risks did Apple disclose regarding third-party outsourced assembly in Asia?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Substantially all manufacturing is performed by outsourced partners located primarily in Asia, exposing company to supply chain bottlenecks, political instability, and logistics delays.
queries.annotation_notes: Item 1A Risk Factors subsection on supply chain and manufacturing dependencies.

queries.research_question: What was Apple's operating cash flow and capital expenditure for fiscal year 2023?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Cash generated by operating activities was $110,543 million; payments for property, plant and equipment were $10,959 million.
queries.annotation_notes: Liquidity and Capital Resources section in Item 7.

queries.research_question: What are Microsoft's primary operating segments and cloud business architecture?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.
queries.annotation_notes: Microsoft Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended June 30, 2023, Item 1 Business.

queries.research_question: What was Microsoft's revenue growth rate in Intelligent Cloud and Azure during fiscal 2023?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Intelligent Cloud revenue increased 17% to $87.9 billion, driven by Azure and other cloud services revenue growth of 29%.
queries.annotation_notes: Microsoft Item 7 MD&A segment performance analysis.

queries.research_question: What cybersecurity and artificial intelligence risks does Microsoft identify in its annual filing?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Risks associated with cyberattacks, security vulnerabilities in cloud platforms, and emerging AI safety and intellectual property uncertainties.
queries.annotation_notes: Item 1A Risk Factors relating to platform security and generative AI.

queries.research_question: What automotive delivery milestones and manufacturing facilities did Tesla report in fiscal 2023?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Delivered 1.81 million vehicles in 2023; production facilities in Fremont, Shanghai, Berlin, and Austin.
queries.annotation_notes: Tesla Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, Item 1.

queries.research_question: How did Tesla's automotive gross margin evolve in 2023 amid vehicle price reductions?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Total automotive gross margin decreased from 28.5% in 2022 to 18.2% in 2023 due to average selling price reductions.
queries.annotation_notes: Tesla Item 7 MD&A automotive revenues and margins discussion.

queries.research_question: What supply chain and lithium battery material dependencies are highlighted by Tesla?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Volatile pricing and availability of raw materials including lithium, nickel, and cobalt, and single-source supplier risks.
queries.annotation_notes: Tesla Item 1A Risk Factors subsection on raw materials and battery cells.

queries.research_question: What drove Nvidia's Compute & Networking and Data Center revenue expansion in fiscal 2024?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Data Center revenue surged 217% to $47.5 billion driven by the NVIDIA HGX platform and Hopper architecture demand for generative AI.
queries.annotation_notes: NVIDIA Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended January 28, 2024, Item 7.

queries.research_question: What export control and trade restrictions does Nvidia face regarding high-performance accelerated computing chips?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: US government licensing requirements and export controls impacting high-end AI semiconductors to China and other targeted markets.
queries.annotation_notes: Item 1A Geopolitical and Export Control disclosures in Nvidia FY2024 10-K.

queries.research_question: What was Apple's research and development expense and proportion of revenue in fiscal 2023?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: R&D expense was $29,915 million, representing approximately 8% of total net sales.
queries.annotation_notes: Operating expenses breakdown in Apple FY2023 10-K MD&A.

queries.research_question: How did Microsoft's operating income and operating margin compare between fiscal 2022 and 2023?
relevant_evidence_descriptions: Operating income was $88.5 billion in fiscal 2023 compared to $83.4 billion in 2022, operating margin remained near 42%.
queries.annotation_notes: Comparative results of operations in Microsoft FY2023 Form 10-K.

queries.research_question: What are the unannotated proprietary disclosures for unlisted microcap company XYZ?
queries.annotation_notes: Intentionally unannotated query for verifying evaluation metrics behavior on empty reference sets.
